cohort: A 7-day-old female neonate presenting with dysmorphic features and multiple congenital anomalies, later diagnosed with partial trisomy 13q and partial trisomy 18p.
finding: This case report describes the first liveborn neonate with coexisting partial trisomy 13q and trisomy 18p, demonstrating array CGH as a valuable diagnostic tool for complex genetic anomalies.
